$comment: Words CLAP scores each sound against (rcg audio-analyzer). Editing this file changes the analysis version, so the next `rcg audio-analyzer library` re-analyses every file. blocked: words CLAP over-uses (the 2026-10 ear test put 'horror' in the top 6 for 8 of 15 tracks, next to 'relaxing'); they are never scored. kindPrompts decide music vs sound effect for a file no manifest names.

moodGroups.$comment: Mood families. A section counts as a mood change only when its top mood falls in another family (calm vs relaxing is not a change). Music words outside these lists are style words (genre, instrument, use) and never count as a change.
